format: Parquet tables plus immutable source JSON artifacts and build manifest
source_patterns_note: Patterns are research mappings, not executable selectors. * denotes one source array level; owner-relative paths must follow the document's scope rules.
normalization_default: No trimming, case folding, label splitting, deduplication, date interpretation, unit conversion or default filling in bronze.
vocabulary_default: Source vocabularies remain open. Newly observed values are retained and reported, not rejected or mapped to other.

types.int64: Parquet signed 64-bit integer; source type mismatch is preserved in raw_json and reported
types.bool: Parquet boolean, only from an actual JSON boolean
types.json: Parquet UTF-8 containing complete JSON; retain primitive types and array order
types.timestamp_us_utc: Parquet timestamp in UTC, only for known acquisition/build times
types.map<string,string>: Parquet MAP with string keys and values
